description: This is the main application widget for a Flutter-based wallet application. It configures MaterialApp with theming, sets up a Scaffold with an AppBar, BottomNavigationBar, and a FloatingActionButton. It manages navigation between Home, Transactions, and Categories screens, and provides functionality to add new transactions via a bottom sheet.

classes.name: WalletApp
classes.description: The root widget for the wallet application, managing navigation and theming.

classes.name: _WalletAppState
classes.description: State class for WalletApp, managing the current tab index and interaction events.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for WalletApp.

methods.name: _onTabTap
methods.description: Handles taps on the bottom navigation bar to update the current tab index.

methods.name: _onFabPressed
methods.description: Opens a bottom sheet to add a new transaction and refreshes the wallet data afterward.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the MaterialApp widget with theming, navigation, and layout.
